title: How One Charging Dock Rewires a Godly Man's Nights
caption:
The fight doesn't happen at 11pm. It happens at 7am, when you decide where the charger goes.

Most men try to out-willpower the phone at the worst possible hour: tired, alone, defenses all the way down. That fight is rigged before it starts.

Move the charger to the kitchen. Put your Bible on the nightstand instead, so your hand finds something heavier than a screen in the dark. Pick a real cutoff hour, not a feeling, and hold it on the boring nights, not just the disciplined ones.

Then give it two weeks before you decide it didn't work. The first few nights feel like nothing changed. A habit gets built in the repetition, not the feeling.

You don't beat a habit with willpower. You beat it with a harder habit for the phone to compete with.

"Let us not grow weary of doing good, for in due season we will reap, if we do not give up." (Galatians 6:9)
